description: Inspection booth slot management system - manage booth counts per inspection type, assign waiting teams to booths, track inspection time, and provide per-team statistics

userStories.title: Add booth and queue_log database tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need database tables to store booth configuration, booth state, booth usage logs, and queue event logs so that booth management and statistics features have persistent storage.
acceptanceCriteria: Create booth_config table: inspection TEXT PRIMARY KEY, count INTEGER DEFAULT 1
Create booth table: inspection TEXT, booth_num INTEGER, active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, occupied_by INTEGER NULL, entered_at INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (inspection, booth_num)
Create booth_log table: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, num INTEGER, inspection TEXT, booth_num INTEGER, entered_at INTEGER, exited_at INTEGER NULL, created_at INTEGER
Create queue_log table: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, event TEXT, num INTEGER, inspection TEXT, timestamp INTEGER
On server startup, auto-create 1 default booth per inspection type in booth_config and booth tables if not already present
Existing tables (inspection, current, team_priority, inspection_history, cancel_penalty, settings, and per-inspection queue tables) remain unchanged
Server starts without errors after adding new tables

userStories.title: Exempt report inspection from duplicate registration constraint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to register for report inspection regardless of existing registrations, and register for other inspections while registered for report, so that report submission does not block other inspections.
acceptanceCriteria: In POST /api/admin/register/:type, when type is 'report' and team is already registered for another inspection, allow registration by appending ',report' to current.inspection

In POST /api/admin/register/:type, when type is not 'report' and team is currently registered only for 'report' (or report + battery/chassis combo), allow registration by appending the new type to current.inspection
Existing battery+chassis simultaneous registration rule remains unchanged
Non-report, non-battery/chassis duplicate registration still returns error
In POST /api/admin/cancel/:type, when cancelling 'report' and team has other inspections, only remove 'report' from current.inspection comma-separated list instead of deleting the current row
In POST /api/admin/cancel/:type, when cancelling a non-report inspection and team also has 'report', only remove that inspection from current.inspection instead of deleting the current row
Server starts without errors

userStories.title: Add queue_log event recording to register and cancel handlers
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to record register and cancel events in queue_log so that statistics can be computed later.
acceptanceCriteria: In POST /api/admin/register/:type, after successful registration insert into queue_log: event='register', num, inspection=type, timestamp=Date.now()
In POST /api/admin/cancel/:type, after successful cancellation insert into queue_log: event='cancel', num, inspection=type, timestamp=Date.now()
queue_log inserts do not affect the existing transaction or response behavior
Server starts without errors

userStories.title: Add SSE booth event broadcasting and frontend useSSE extension
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the SSE system to support booth events so that all clients receive real-time booth status updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend: broadcastEvent supports 'booth' event type with data { type: inspectionType, booths: [...boothObjects] }
Backend: GET /api/events init event includes allBooths object containing booth arrays keyed by inspection type
Frontend useSSE.js: Add allBooths ref (object keyed by inspection type) and lastBoothUpdate ref
Frontend useSSE.js: Handle 'init' event to populate allBooths from initial data
Frontend useSSE.js: Handle 'booth' event to update allBooths[type] and set lastBoothUpdate with { type, timestamp }
useSSE composable exports allBooths, lastBoothUpdate alongside existing exports

userStories.title: Add booth config and toggle API endpoints
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to change the number of booths per inspection type and enable/disable individual booths via API.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/admin/booths/:type returns array of booth objects { booth_num, active, occupied_by, entered_at } for the inspection type

PATCH /api/admin/booths/:type/config accepts { count: number }. When count > current, add new booth rows. When count < current, delete unoccupied booths with highest booth_num first. Return error if occupied booths would be deleted
PATCH /api/admin/booths/:type/:boothNum accepts { active: boolean }. Return error if trying to deactivate an occupied booth
All three endpoints broadcast SSE 'booth' event with updated booth list for that inspection type
All endpoints validate inspection type exists
Server starts without errors

userStories.title: Add booth enter and exit API endpoints
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to assign a waiting team to an empty booth and release a team from a booth when inspection is complete.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/admin/booths/:type/:boothNum/enter accepts { num: number }. Validates: team exists in that inspection's queue table, booth is active and not occupied. In a transaction: remove team from queue table, decrement inspection.length, update booth row (occupied_by=num, entered_at=now), insert booth_log row, insert queue_log event='enter', remove inspection type from current.inspection (or delete current row if last inspection)

POST /api/admin/booths/:type/:boothNum/exit with no body. Validates booth is occupied. In a transaction: update booth row (occupied_by=NULL, entered_at=NULL), update booth_log row with exited_at=now, insert into inspection_history
Enter endpoint sends SMS notification to sms_rank-th person in queue (reuse existing SMS logic from the old enter endpoint)
Both endpoints broadcast SSE 'booth' event and 'queue' event
Server starts without errors

userStories.title: Add public booth status API endpoint
userStories.description: As a public user, I want to view current booth status without authentication so I can see inspection availability.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/booths/:type returns array of booth objects { booth_num, active, occupied_by, entered_at } for the given inspection type
GET /api/booths/all returns all booths grouped by inspection type as an object { battery: [...], electric: [...], ... }
Endpoints require no authentication (under /api path which is already public in nginx)
Returns 400 for invalid inspection type
Server starts without errors

userStories.title: Migrate existing enter endpoint and add booth reset on history clear
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to deprecate the old enter endpoint and ensure history reset also clears booth state.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing POST /api/admin/enter/:type endpoint is kept but marked deprecated with a comment. It can remain functional as-is for backward compatibility
DELETE /api/admin/history/:type handler additionally resets all booths for that inspection type: UPDATE booth SET occupied_by=NULL, entered_at=NULL WHERE inspection=type
After booth reset, broadcast SSE 'booth' event for that inspection type
Booth_log records with NULL exited_at from before the reset remain as-is (incomplete records)
Server starts without errors

userStories.title: Add statistics API endpoints
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to query per-team inspection statistics and detailed timelines so I can monitor event operations.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/admin/stats accepts optional query params: from (unix timestamp), to (unix timestamp), inspection (type string). Returns array of { num, registrations, cancellations, entries, totalOccupyTime } computed from queue_log and booth_log

registrations = count of queue_log where event='register', cancellations = event='cancel', entries = event='enter', totalOccupyTime = sum of (exited_at - entered_at) from booth_log where exited_at is not null

GET /api/admin/stats/:num accepts same filter params. Returns { summary: {registrations, cancellations, entries, totalOccupyTime}, timeline: [{inspection, boothNum, registeredAt, enteredAt, exitedAt, occupyDuration}] }
Timeline is sorted by timestamp ascending, combining queue_log and booth_log records for that team
When from/to not provided, return all data. When inspection not provided, aggregate all types
Server starts without errors
